newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums narrowly weaker, outrights steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums narrowly weaker, outrights steady.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums were a touch weaker on Wednesday, but firmer IPE gas oil futures kept outright prices broadly steady.
Traders said activity remained very slow with much of the market still at industry functions in London.
"There's nothing really going on, not enough people to make it a true market," said one trader.
Jet barges were pegged at March IPE +$24 fob, up to $1 off Tuesday's levels. "There's no interest at $25," said one dealer. Cargoes were assessed up to $26-27 cif NWE.
